focus_areas: Text legibility on the yellow fabric
Geometric correctness of small disassembled parts (springs/pins)
Structural connection between scope rings and Picatinny rail
Completeness of firearm components (magazine insertion, stock attachment)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the yellow fabric; AI generators frequently produce gibberish here. Scrutinize the small metal parts near the right side for signs of 'melting' or lack of distinct mechanical geometry. Crucially, verify the physical connection between the scope rings and the top rail to ensure there is no floating or geometric distortion.
